project.name: Numou Commerce - Promotion Aggregator
project.description: Commerce Promotion Capability (product01.md Phase F + product03.md): Promotion / PromotionRule / conditions / actions / stacking policy / PromotionEngine / PromotionCompiler / PromotionResult. Applies one or more promotions to a priced cart (PriceResult). Default stacking is BEST_RESULT (single winner, v1-compatible); STACK and EXCLUSIVE are supported. Consumes pricing downstream only.
